Parts of the -381,778: (a) 175,527 + 11,251 = 186,778 are premium and insurance proceeds, printed the same on p5 and recorded in JSON other_financing, not debt proceeds (no error); (b) 195,000 Special Assessments debt proceeds are printed only on the budgetary-basis schedule p16; the GAAP statement p5 prints no issuance in the Special Assessments column. Budgetary vs GAAP basis; the 20,285,000 ties exactly. No fix.

Adding the GAAP-only 8,196 would mix bases in a fund that has its own printed schedule; not added. All other p5 fund-column other-financing rows are in detail[] (Other Governmental Funds transfers in 1,008,136 = Region 11 51,120 + Economic Development 170,716 + Dispatch 786,300; out (116,378) = Region 11 (6,300) + Wireless 911 (110,078)); all transfer labels have the right sign.
